# AWS DevSecOps Agent

Drives AWS DevOps Agent and AWS Security Agent: incident root-cause investigations, release-readiness reviews and UAT, code and diff security scans, threat modeling, penetration tests, and finding remediation.

## Agent

This is an **agent plugin**: every skill, command, hook, and MCP server below is bound to the [`aws-devsecops-agent`](./agents/aws-devsecops-agent.md) agent, which the host runtime spawns as a dynamic sub-agent.

- Claude Code: `@agent-aws-devsecops-agent:aws-devsecops-agent` or let Claude delegate based on the agent description
- Headless: `claude --agent aws-devsecops-agent:aws-devsecops-agent`

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `analyzing-release-readiness` | Trigger a pre-merge release readiness review on a GitHub PR, GitLab MR, or local branch. |
| `chatting-with-aws-devops-agent` | Have a fast, conversational analysis with the AWS DevOps Agent. |
| `coordinating-multi-space-devops-agent` | Coordinate the AWS DevOps Agent across multiple AgentSpaces from one Claude Code session — route questions to the right space (prod vs staging vs knowledge), query several spaces in parallel and synthesize, or compare f… |
| `diff-scanning-with-aws-security-agent` | Run a fast AWS Security Agent diff scan on only the changed code since a git ref. |
| `investigating-incidents-with-aws-devops-agent` | Run a deep root-cause investigation on the AWS DevOps Agent. |
| `pentesting-with-aws-security-agent` | Run an AWS Security Agent penetration test against a live web application — registers and verifies the target domain, exercises the supplied endpoints with the managed Security Agent service, and returns verified runtim… |
| `remediating-with-aws-security-agent` | Pull AWS Security Agent findings (penetration tests and code reviews) and drive remediation. |
| `running-release-tests` | Run automated release testing (UI or API) via the AWS DevOps Agent using a pre-configured test profile. |
| `scanning-with-aws-security-agent` | Run an AWS Security Agent scan on the workspace — uploads the source to AWS, scans it with the managed Security Agent service, and returns ranked, verified findings with code locations and remediations. |
| `setup` | Set up the AWS DevOps Agent and AWS Security Agent connections. |
| `setup-devops-agent` | Setup and diagnostics for the AWS DevOps Agent MCP connection. |
| `setup-security-agent` | Configure AWS Security Agent for the current workspace — provision or reuse an agent space, IAM service role, and S3 bucket. |
| `signing-in-to-aws` | Gets AWS credentials for CLI/SDK access via `aws login`. |
| `threat-modeling-with-aws-security-agent` | Run an AWS Security Agent threat model review on spec/design documents. |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/aws-devsecops-agent:chat` | Open a chat session with the AWS DevOps Agent and ask a question |
| `/aws-devsecops-agent:cost` | Ask the AWS DevOps Agent for cost optimization opportunities, scoped to your local IaC |
| `/aws-devsecops-agent:investigate` | Start a deep root-cause investigation on the AWS DevOps Agent and stream progress |
| `/aws-devsecops-agent:release-readiness` | Trigger a pre-merge release readiness review on a GitHub PR, GitLab MR, or local branch |
| `/aws-devsecops-agent:release-testing` | Run automated UAT tests (UI or API) using a test profile on the AWS DevOps Agent |
| `/aws-devsecops-agent:setup-devops-agent` | Set up the AWS DevOps Agent MCP connection |
| `/aws-devsecops-agent:setup-security-agent` | Set up the AWS Security Agent workspace |
| `/aws-devsecops-agent:setup` | Set up both AWS DevOps Agent and AWS Security Agent connections |
| `/aws-devsecops-agent:spaces` | List configured AgentSpaces and summarize each one's accounts and capabilities |

## MCP servers

Declared in [`.mcp.json`](./.mcp.json) and bound to the agent through its `tools:` allowlist.

| Server | Transport | Launch | Agent tool pattern | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aws-devops-agent` | http | `https://connect.aidevops.${DEVOPS_AGENT_REGION:-us-east-1}.api.aws/mcp` | `mcp__plugin_aws-devsecops-agent_aws-devops-agent__*` |  |
| `security-agent` | stdio | `uvx awslabs.security-agent-mcp-server@latest` | `mcp__plugin_aws-devsecops-agent_security-agent__*` | AWS Security Agent scans and pentests. No read-only mode: first use may provision an agent space and IAM role, so confirm before running. |

AWS credentials are inherited from the host environment (`AWS_PROFILE`, SSO, or instance role). `AWS_REGION` defaults to `us-east-1` when unset. Toggle any server off per project in `/mcp`.
